title: Graphic Designer
description:
Ink Media is a boutique marketing and design agency based in Pune. We’re looking for a skilled graphic designer with a strong eye for typography, layout and detail, who can create thoughtful, polished work across digital and print.

You’ll work closely with our Creative Director, translating established creative direction into designs that are on brand, ready for client presentation and correctly prepared for production.

Most of your work will involve static design, branding and print collateral. You should also be comfortable editing short-form social videos. Advanced motion graphics are an added advantage.

What you’ll work on

* Brand identity assets, including logo variations, typography and colour systems, and basic usage guidelines, developed under the Creative Director’s guidance.
* Social campaigns, carousels and digital creatives for Instagram, LinkedIn and other platforms.
* Brochures, signage, billboards and other print collateral, including preparing and checking artwork for production.
* Presentation mockups that show designs in context.
* Short-form social videos, including editing, captioning, resizing and adapting content for different platforms.
* Organised, clearly named, editable files that are ready for handoff.
* Simple client discussions about briefs, revisions and feedback, with support from the team.

As you grow into the role, you’ll also help check junior designers’ work for consistency, accuracy and quality.

What we’re looking for

* A strong portfolio demonstrating brochure or multi-page layout design and social campaign work.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop and Canva.
* Strong fundamentals in typography, composition, visual hierarchy and brand consistency.
* The ability to prepare print-ready artwork, including appropriate bleed, colour settings, image resolution and exports.
* The ability to edit and assemble short-form videos using a tool you’re comfortable with.
* Comfort communicating in English and Hindi, and a willingness to develop your client communication skills.
* Careful attention to detail, responsiveness during working hours and reliable delivery against agreed deadlines.
* The ability to work with creative direction and incorporate feedback thoughtfully.

Freshers with excellent portfolios and experienced designers are both welcome.

For freshers, clearly labelled academic or self-initiated projects are welcome.

Additional advantages

* Experience designing for real estate or luxury brands.
* Familiarity with Figma, Premiere Pro or After Effects.
* Basic motion graphics skills.
* Photography or videography skills for on-site shoots.

Working arrangement

* Candidates must currently live in Pune and be available for in-person meetings approximately once a week.
* The role is mostly remote, with fixed availability required during these hours:
* Monday–Friday: 10:30 am–6:30 pm IST
* Saturday: 10:30 am–2:00 pm IST
* Software licences will be provided. Having your own suitable computer is preferred; a computer can be provided if required.
* We’re looking for someone who can join as soon as possible.

What you can expect

Close collaboration with our Creative Director, ownership of substantial design work, varied client projects and opportunities to develop your skills within a positive, open working culture.

How to apply

Please submit both your resume and portfolio. Include a working portfolio link prominently in your resume, with any access password provided.

Your portfolio should include brochure or multi-page layout work and social campaign creatives. Please identify your contribution to collaborative projects and include any available short-form video examples.

Applications without a resume and an accessible portfolio will not be considered.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short call to discuss their work and suitability for the role.

title: Curriculum Designer
description:
**About the Program**

ProblemSolvers Lab (PSL) began with a simple idea:
**all students can engage in deep, higher- order thinking when they have the right environment and the right kind of mathematical experiences.**

Across many classrooms in India, students rarely get opportunities to think aloud, explore structure, make conjectures, work with peers, or experience the satisfaction of figuring something out. PSL was created to bring these opportunities into everyday instruction.

Our work is grounded in a few design principles:

* **Low-floor, high-ceiling tasks**
  that allow every student to enter and stretch
* **Productive struggle**
  , where students test ideas, revise, and persist
* Seeing students as
  **visualizers, experimenters, and problem-solvers**
  , not passive recipients

Everything we do, with teachers and with students, rests on this approach.

**Role Overview**

We are hiring a Curriculum Designer to design and refine our problem solving curriculum. This role is about much more than writing lesson plans. It involves researching ideas, gathering insights from classrooms, consulting with experts, and experimenting with creative ways to make problem-solving joyful and rigorous.

You will have the opportunity to learn deeply about curriculum and pedagogy while collaborating with a team passionate about mathematics, puzzles, games, and problem-solving. You will also get the experience of marrying your ideas with ground realities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Curriculum Research & Design**

* Research mathematical problems, puzzles, and global practices to inform curriculum design
* Develop coherent modules with clear goals and progression across grades
* Write detailed, teacher-friendly lesson plans that anticipate student thinking and support rich classroom discussions
* Develop clear, accessible student handouts, manipulatives, and other learning materials
* Align lessons with grade-level mathematics while preserving the depth of PSL’s problem-solving approach.

**Classroom Testing and Improvement**

* Pilot lessons and materials with students and teachers
* Observe classrooms, review student work, and identify what is and is not working
* Refine lessons and materials based on classroom evidence and feedback
* Gather and synthesize inputs from facilitators, teachers, program managers, and experts

**Assessment and Evidence of Learning**

* Design assessments and performance tasks that capture students’ problem-solving, collaboration, and intellectual risk-taking skills
* Develop student reflection tools and identify meaningful artefacts of learning
* Analyse student work and assessment results to strengthen the curriculum

**Training and Program Support**

* Support the design of induction and training sessions for teachers and facilitators
* Adapt lessons for different grades, languages, and classroom contexts
* Work closely with program and partnership teams to support curriculum alignment, classroom implementation, and learning from integration pilots
* Contribute to the design of hackathons, showcases, and other student-facing learning experiences

**Qualifications and Experience**

* At least
  **2 years of classroom experience**
  teaching mathematics
* Master’s degree in Mathematics Education (preferred)
* Strong research, writing, and design skills
* Organized, thoughtful, detail-oriented, and creative
* Enjoys
  **puzzles, games, and problem-solving**
  , and brings that joy into curriculum design
* Proactive collaborator who can synthesize feedback into stronger curriculum design
* Passionate about mathematics and making problem-solving joyful and accessible

**Skills and Mindsets**

* **Curious about student thinking**
  : Pays close attention to how students approach problems, where they get stuck, and what helps them move forward
* **Strong curriculum thinker**
  : Can connect learning goals, lesson design, classroom facilitation, and assessment
* **Collaborative learner**
  : Seeks feedback, listens carefully, and adapts based on classroom evidence and input from teachers and colleagues
* **Iterative and reflective**
  : Is willing to test ideas, learn from what does not work, and revise materials substantially
* **Ownership and attention to detail**
  : Manages work independently, follows through, and maintains high standards for accuracy and clarity
* **Creative problem-solver**
  : Enjoys exploring multiple possibilities and finding practical ways to make rigorous learning accessible and joyful

**What We Offer**

* Significant ownership in shaping PSL’s problem-solving curriculum
* Opportunities to test ideas in classrooms and learn directly from students and teachers
* Close collaboration with educators, mathematics education experts, and program teams
* Autonomy to research, experiment, and improve the curriculum through multiple iterations
* Opportunities to deepen your understanding of mathematics education, curriculum design, and problem-solving pedagogy

**Job Description**
**Vice President, Product Designer**
We're seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Product Designer, AI Hub to join our Digital Channels team. This role is based in Pune.
  
  
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Make complexity clear - Take systems that are genuinely hard: multi-step workflows, cross-platform journeys, enterprise-scale data. Design experiences that make sense to the people who depend on them. Understand the problem at depth before touching anything.
* Drive concept development from day one - Bring ideas from research and outcomes to prototyped form fast. Demonstrate possibilities rather than describing them. Use AI-assisted tools to close the distance between design intent and working experience.
* Own the design of end-to-end experiences - Map journeys across users, teams, and systems. Identify where things break, where friction accumulates, and what needs to be rebuilt versus refined. Operate across the full scope of a platform experience, not just the screens in front of you.
* Contribute to a design system built for how design works now - Our design system is structured as machine-readable infrastructure, not just a component library. Tokens carry semantic meaning. Patterns encode reasoning about when and why they apply. AI agents consume it directly alongside human developers. Contributing here means adding to the grammar, not just the vocabulary, and understanding why that distinction matters.
* Communicate design as a point of view, not a deliverable - Articulate the rationale behind decisions. Help product managers and engineers understand the tradeoffs. Make design legible to people who don't speak design, without dumbing it down.
* Mentor through example. Raise the standard of work around you through critique, collaboration, and how you approach problems. Not through title.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Bring The Following Expertise**

* Typically, 10 -14 years of experience, or equivalent demonstrated through portfolio and impact.
* Strong product design fundamentals: research synthesis, interaction design, systems thinking, visual craft
* Experience designing complex systems: enterprise software, multi-step workflows, data-heavy interfaces
* Demonstrated comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the problem isn't handed to you pre-formed
* The ability to communicate design rationale to mixed audiences (product, engineering, business) and hold your perspective under pressure

**Preferred**

* You already work with AI-assisted tools, not just for ideation, but for building and prototyping
* You've worked in shared codebases or repos with cross-functional teams, or you're actively moving in that direction

**What Will Set You Apart**

* You work at the intersection of design and technical implementation, close to the material, not downstream from it
* You've felt the industry shift happening and leaned toward it
* Your process produces things, not documents

You have a deep excitement for and understanding of the opportunity that AI creates for design, even if you haven't fully arrived there yet, you're moving fast
  
  
**A portfolio is required, but what we most want to see may not look like a traditional design portfolio.**
The most compelling thing you can share is evidence of how you actually create products: working alongside product managers and engineers in real time, from research to something shippable, in a way that reflects how modern product teams operate. Show us a process, a repo, a prototype you built directly, a decision you influenced in the room. If you've worked in a shared codebase or repo with cross-functional partners, bring that to life. If you've used AI tools to get from insight to working experience faster, bring that to life.
  
  
Beyond that, we want to see what you'd expect: complex systems thinking, end-to-end journey work, evidence of design decisions that improved the experience and why. Components encode the reasoning behind when and how they apply. AI agents consume it alongside human developers. At the SVP level, you're not just contributing to this grammar, you're shaping how it's defined and ensuring it reflects the quality and intent of the experiences we're building.

* Enterprise craft. Demonstrated success delivering UX for complex, enterprise\-grade products, operating at both strategic and execution levels on ambiguous, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Complex domains. Experience in domains such as finance, banking, insurance, or healthcare, including data\-heavy workflows and logic\-based systems (formulas, rules, algorithms).

description:
**About HG**
 HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI\- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points.

Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first\-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI\-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're seeking a passionate and experienced Principal UX Designer to serve as our Head of UX, owning the user experience design process from concept to delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong advocate for the user, with a track record of creating intuitive, accessible, and engaging digital experiences — and is comfortable operating as a design team of one, balancing hands\-on execution with strategic ownership. You'll be the primary voice for UX across the product organization, translating user needs and business goals into effective design solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the end\-to\-end UX design process, from initial research and ideation through wireframing, prototyping, and final implementation.
* Conduct and lead user research and usability testing to deeply understand user behavior, needs, and pain points. Synthesize findings into actionable design insights.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to define product strategy, requirements, and features.
* Create and maintain design deliverables such as user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity mockups using industry\-standard tools.
* Champion user\-centered design principles and best practices across the organization, ensuring design decisions are data\-informed and user\-validated.
* Own and maintain the design system to ensure consistency and scalability across products.
* Manage external design contractors or agencies as needed to supplement capacity.
* Set the design function's standards and processes — critique cadence, research practices, tooling — even as a team of one, so they can scale as the team grows.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years of professional experience in a UX design role, with at least 5 years in a senior or principal capacity.
* A strong portfolio that demonstrates expertise in user research, interaction design, and visual design.
* Proven ability to operate as a design team of one — balancing strategic ownership with hands\-on execution, and managing competing stakeholder priorities without a team to delegate to.
* Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Sketch; familiarity with AI\-assisted design/prototyping tools is a plus.
* Proven experience leading user research methodologies (e.g., interviews, surveys, usability tests) and data analysis.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to a variety of audiences, including senior leadership.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment is highly desirable.
* A bachelor's degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field is preferred.
* Familiarity with GTM Intelligence and data platforms is a strong plus.
* Significant overlap with US business hours is required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving, with the judgment to prioritize independently.
* User\-centered design and design thinking methodologies.
* Information architecture and interaction design.
* Empathy for users and the ability to advocate for their needs.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration, especially in the absence of a design team to lean on.


**What We Offer/Benefits**
 We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.
   

  

 We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club, you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.
